key_insight: Deep Self-Training Graph Partition Aggregation (ST-GPA) strengthens certified robustness to training-time label and graph-structure poisoning by addressing sparsity within graph partitions.
engineering_relevance: The architecture-agnostic framework offers a way to add poisoning robustness guarantees to graph-learning pipelines while maintaining strong clean accuracy.
method: Partition graph data for partition-and-aggregation certification.
Enrich sparse partitions with informative pseudo-labels and synthetic edges through deep self-training.
Aggregate partition-level predictions to certify robustness against label and structure poisoning.
evidence_signal: Across multiple benchmarks, the abstract reports consistently and significantly improved robustness guarantees against both poisoning types, strong clean accuracy, and scalability to large numbers of partitions.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify certified attack budgets or computational overhead, so deployment-specific robustness and cost require further assessment.
paper_title: Certifying Graph Neural Networks Against Label and Structure Poisoning
